accounts.title: Bank accounts
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Add one to start tracking expenses.

form.name: Name *
form.coOwnersHint: Selected people see this account and its transactions as if it were theirs, in addition to the owner.
form.settlementHint: The checking account the monthly summary charge is billed to. Used to recognize and avoid double counting when you import that account's statement.
form.cardNumberHint: Helps the AI automatically recognize the account when you import a statement for this card.
form.amountSignModeHint: How to interpret the sign of amounts when you import a file for this card. Leave "Automatic" unless the import flips expenses and credits.
form.amountSignModeFlip: Expenses always positive in the file (needs flipping)
form.amountSignModeSigned: Already correctly signed (expenses negative, like American Express)

openingBalance.title: Opening balance — {name}
openingBalance.empty: No opening balance set: the account balance starts at zero and sums every transaction.
openingBalance.hint: One checkpoint per calendar year: the account balance is computed as the latest checkpoint (by date) plus every transaction after it. Adding a new checkpoint each year lets you realign the balance to the real bank statement.
